description: Run JavaScript in an isolated QuickJS sandbox with a typed tg object, for multi-step work that would otherwise need many tool calls: bulk edits, cross-ad analysis, pagination, joins and reports. Only console.log output and the returned value come back. No network, filesystem, process or env access. Calls run sequentially; the limit is 25 API calls, 15 seconds and 64 KB of output. Example: `const ads = await tg.getAdsList({limit: 100}); return ads.ads.length`. Write methods require TG_ADS_MODE=write, TG_ADS_CODE_MODE=write and confirm: true.

code.description: An async arrow function, a function expression, or a plain statement body.

confirm.description: Required before any write method can run.

idempotency_key.description: Prefix for write idempotency keys, useful when retrying a script.

name: tg_execute
title: Execute a Telegram Ads script
